sections.title: Summary
sections.text: Tested annular preventer 13-5/8" with 300 PSI low and 7000PSI high - OK. Tested upper ram preventer and observed leak in plug. Waited for test plug from VETCO company. Progress 25% of BOP testing.

sections.title: Next Operation
sections.text: Test BOPs, assemble string with PDC bit 10-5/8" and directional string. Run to +/- 3,521 M. Displace mud 2.05 GR/CC x 1.95 GR/CC.

sections.title: Observations
sections.text: IPC company personnel changed hydraulics of pumps 1 and 2 of equipment to 5-1/2" X 11".

sections.title: Previous Day Summary
sections.text: Pulled bit to 3,498 MT. Performed mud displacement from 1.95 GR/CC x 2.05 GR/CC. Removed sealing element and installed bell nipple. Raised bit to 989 M. IPC personnel slipped cable.

events.description: PDC bit wear: 0-0-NO-A-X-I-NO-BHA. First stabilizer wear (below reamer): 1/8". Second stabilizer wear (above reamer): 1/16". Rhino reamer wear: 0-0-NO-A-X-I-NO-BHA
By request of operating unit, thread protectors were not placed on TP 5 7/8" XT-57
Waiting for VETCO GREY company to recover wear bushing

Multiple attempts to test BOPs 13-5/8"-10M without success. Cup tester did not seal. Changed test cup multiple times without success. Hydraulic fluid hose failure in test unit. Leak observed in test plug O-ring. Only 25% BOP test progress achieved.
Successfully tested spherical preventer 13-5/8"-10M with 300PSI low and 7000PSI high for 40 minutes - OK

operations.details: Pulled PDC bit 10-5/8" from 989 M to surface, disconnecting rotary string equipped with Power Drive / MWD / Rhino reamer 10" x 12-1/4". Monitored well fill every 5 stands with sheet and trip tank.

Waiting for VETCO GREY company to recover wear bushing. Meanwhile: PROPESA company personnel and test unit tested choke assembly (valve x valve) with 300 PSI low and 8000 PSI high - OK. IPC company personnel tested mud pumps with new hydraulics 5-1/2"X11" and checked electric motor N.1 of main drawworks.
With VETCO GRAY company personnel recovered wear bushing.

With PROPESA company unit installed cup tester, attempted to test BOPs 13-5/8"-10M repeatedly without success. Changed cup and attempted to test again without success. Pulled tester to surface and changed to VETCO test plug and tested spherical preventer 13-5/8"-10M with 300PSI low and 7000PSI high for 40 min - OK. Due to test unit failure, repaired hydraulic fluid hose failure. Attempted to test upper ram preventer and blind ram observing leak in test plug O-ring. Connected cup tester with extension and attempted to test again without success, observed that PROPESA test cup does not seal. Requested another test cup from PROPESA, installed new cup and attempted to test again without success, cup did not seal. Waited for VETCO test plug and installed it. Current BOP test progress 13-5/8"-10M with 300PSI low and 8000PSI high: 25%

sections.text:

sections.title: Litología (Lithology)
sections.text:
LITOLOGIA A 5,400 M: 80% MUDSTONE GRIS CLARO, CAFE CLARO Y BLANCO CREMA EN PARTES DOLOMITICO, LIGERAMENTE ARCILLOSO, ALGUNOS FRAGMENTOS PRESENTAN LINEAS MICROESTILILITICAS SELLADAS POR MATERIAL ARCILLO BITUMINOSO, ALGUNOS FRAGMENTOS PRESENTAN PARCHES DE ANHIDRITA, ALGUNOS FRAGMENTOS PRESENTAN MICROFRACTURAS SELLADAS POR CALCITA. 20% ANHIDRITA BLANCA. ESPORADICO FRAGMENTOS DE PACKSTONE DE PELOIDE, OOIDES CAFE CLARO Y GRIS CLARO. SOLUBILIDAD GENERAL 40 %
English: LITHOLOGY AT 5,400 M: 80% LIGHT GRAY, LIGHT BROWN AND WHITE CREAM MUDSTONE, PARTLY DOLOMITIC, SLIGHTLY CLAYEY, SOME FRAGMENTS PRESENT MICROSTYLOLITIC LINES SEALED BY CLAY-BITUMINOUS MATERIAL, SOME FRAGMENTS PRESENT PATCHES OF ANHYDRITE, SOME FRAGMENTS PRESENT MICROFRACTURES SEALED BY CALCITE. 20% WHITE ANHYDRITE.
